arStrings.szText: Not mean, but her mind is suddenly on other things. She feels driven by something within, a newfound purpose (not a sinister purpose, to her it is a very positive one).
I have the writings I came for. No reason to linger.

Concerned. His friend just went through a lot, but she seems to be getting over it too easily. This is a gentle, warm-hearted concern, not suspicion.
